title: Immunohistochemistry for Factor VIII
author: Jennifer Rutkowsky
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.56qg9dw

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Mount four-micron thick, formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissue sections on charged slides and air-dry overnight at 37ºC.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Treat Sections
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize sections through xylene to 100% reagent alcohol, then treat with 0.3% hydrogen peroxide in 100% methanol for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Rehydrate Sections
steps.instruction: Rehydrate sections to deionized water through 95% and 70% reagent alcohols.

steps.title: Perform Antigen Retrieval
steps.instruction: Perform antigen retrieval based on the target antibody.

substeps.instruction: For IBA-1: Use heat induced epitope retrieval in a Black & Decker Steamer with Target Retrieval Solution, pH 6 (Dako S1699) for 30 minutes at 95ºC, followed by a 20 minute cool down.
For Factor VIII: Use Proteinase K (Dako S3020) at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Rinse and Buffer Sections
steps.instruction: Rinse slides in deionized water and place in 0.1M Phosphate Buffered Saline (PBS), pH 7.4.

steps.title: Block and Incubate Primary Antibodies
steps.instruction: Perform blocking and primary antibody incubation in a humidity chamber at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Block sections for 20 minutes using 10% normal horse serum (NHS) in PBS-Tween 20 (0.02%).
Apply primary antibodies without rinsing and incubate for 1 hour.

steps.title: Rinse After Primary Incubation
steps.instruction: Rinse samples twice for three minutes with PBS-Tween 20.

steps.title: Apply HRP Labeling
steps.instruction: Apply HRP labeling based on the target antibody.

substeps.instruction: For rabbit anti-IBA-1: Apply single step, polymer based HRP (BioCare Medical, RC542H) for 30 minutes.

For rabbit anti-Factor VIII: Apply dual step, biotin-avidin based HRP (Biocare Medical, 4+ Detection System GR608) for 10 minutes, followed by Streptavidin-HRP (Biocare Medical HP604) for 10 minutes to label the biotin link.
Visualize labels with NovaRed for peroxidase (Vector SK-4800) per manufacturer's instructions.
